scene_prompts.prompt: Create ONE finished landscape 16:9 environment photograph, 2048x1152 if supported. Scene LH-COMMERCE-2-HERO-ENVIRONMENT-B1, a NEW adjacent side-chapel view of the EXACT dark Gothic cathedral world in the supplied Love Hurts hero reference. This is an empty architectural background plate for a high-end fashion campaign, NOT a redesigned hero, NOT a collage. The same cathedral seen from a physically adjacent side chapel, camera at 1.25m with a restrained 32mm architectural lens, three-quarter view opening diagonally through a tall pointed stone arch onto the original deep rose aisle. Strong identity anchors from the reference: almost-black carved Gothic stone, tightly pointed arches, black thorn vines entwining high columns, narrow stained-glass windows emitting deep controlled crimson red, sparse real candles recessed into the architecture, wet obsidian flagstones reflecting small crimson glints. In deep mid-background, the original story focal point remains recognizable: a single vivid red rose beneath a clear glass bell jar on a narrow stone altar, reached by shallow worn steps, receiving a narrow warm shaft of overhead light. Foreground is a spacious, usable, relatively unobstructed black-stone side chapel floor, center-right 45% empty for a separately composited full-body model later. Keep believable floor plane and vertical geometry, subtly worn edges, scattered small rose petals only near walls and steps, tactile water and stone, cathedral-scale depth. Include a low EMPTY round stepped black stone plinth at far left edge to echo the hero's monument architecture without copying the monument. Cinematic physically believable optical image, tightly controlled blacks with readable shadow detail, subtle volumetric atmosphere, no red floodlight or excessive bloom. Gothic romantic tragedy, intimate and monumental, unmistakably inside this supplied cathedral, not a generic palace/hallway/church or sci-fi room. CRITICAL: completely unoccupied, no humans, no cloaked silhouette, no statues of people, no clothes, products or mannequins. DO NOT generate any lettering, typography, signage, Love Hurts wordmark, star emblem, heart sculpture, rose-logo sculpture or brand artwork; exact brand art will be composited separately from original sources. The glass-encased real rose is environmental storytelling, not a logo. No borders, frames, contact sheets, watermarks or inset reference image. Reference is visual architecture/material/lighting authority, not permission to retain the foreground person or giant text.

Strong reference continuity through a large matte-black architectural wall and deep straight-edged projecting roof framing the left, sparse tiny uplights washing grainy dark wall material; wall is blank, no words. Other architectural elements minimal, open bay sightline. Dense calm noir atmosphere; distant shore lights and atmospheric haze, readable material shadows, controlled hard moonlit rim highlights, subtle weathering, not flat black, no exaggerated smoke. Do not repaint or fabricate the original brand artwork. Generate only the product-free environment surrounding space and empty stone monument base.
